question: How is Śiva-form-ness present in all beings without exception?
premises: All beings are included in the scope of manifestation.
Each being can be understood in relation to Śiva.
Śiva-form-ness is affirmed as their underlying nature.
inference: Thus, in all beings, that Śiva-form-ness is present.
plain_english: Thus, in all beings, that state of being Śiva's form is present.
